description: Update your Himalayas profile. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

career_company_size.description: Company size preferences, e.g. {'1-10': 'not_interested', '51-200': 'preferred'}. Replaces all current size preferences, so include every size the user cares about.

career_compensation.description: How the user feels about equity as part of pay

career_description.description: Description of what you're looking for

career_interested_role_list.description: Other roles the user is interested in. Replaces the current list.

career_skill_list.description: Skills for job matching (e.g. ['Product design', 'User research']). Replaces the current list.

career_working_permits.description: Countries the user can legally work in, as country names (e.g. ['United States']). Replaces the current list.

contact_email.description: Email shown to employers, if different from the login email

email_visible.description: Show the contact email on the profile

first_name.description: First name, as shown on the profile and tailored resumes

location.description: Country name (e.g. 'United States', 'Australia'). Cities and 'City, Country' strings are not accepted.

seniority.description: Seniority levels the user wants. Replaces the current list.

username.description: New username: 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dashes or underscores. The profile moves to himalayas.app/@username and the old link stops working.

visibility.description: public_profile: employers can find and view it. unsearchable_profile: viewable by link but not in search. private_profile: only the user sees it.

name: update_profile
